description: Hello, Traveler! Windtrace, is open once more in a new form! The hunt is nigh in the Contested Zones. Will the Rebels have the upper hand, or will the Hunter come out on top this time? Snap pictures of the exciting moments in the event and share them for a chance to obtain Primogems!
